cases.name: basename_nested_default_nil
cases.contract: Omitted Nil default short-circuits the left-associated three-term chain; matches returns false.

cases.name: basename_single_and_default_nil
cases.contract: One && with omitted Nil returns false.

cases.name: basename_nested_explicit_nil
cases.contract: An explicitly supplied Nil short-circuits and returns false.

cases.name: basename_nested_supplied_non_nil
cases.contract: A supplied Suffix has bytesize 1, so both comparisons run and matches returns true.

cases.name: basename_nested_nil_formal
cases.contract: A Nil-only formal is false and the nested condition returns false.

cases.name: basename_effectful_stable_local_nil
cases.contract: The assignment captures one effectful left evaluation as stable local `seen`; Nil selects false=>A or true=>B after exactly one X marker.

cases.name: basename_effectful_stable_local_non_nil
cases.contract: The assignment captures one effectful left evaluation as stable local `seen`; non-Nil selects false=>A or true=>B after exactly one X marker.

cases.name: filter_nil_local_and_missing_method
cases.contract: Stock resolves and rejects the missing call even though the Nil-typed local makes the runtime RHS unreachable.

cases.name: filter_nil_local_nested_bytesize_plus_missing
cases.contract: Stock resolves and rejects the missing call even though the Nil-typed local makes the runtime RHS unreachable.

cases.name: filter_nested_nil_local_missing_method
cases.contract: Stock resolves and rejects the missing call even though the Nil-typed local makes the runtime RHS unreachable.

cases.name: filter_nil_local_unknown_constant_rejects
cases.contract: Constant-name resolution should remain strict even if runtime truthiness would skip the RHS.

cases.name: filter_nil_local_value_semantics
cases.original_diagnostic: expected argument #1 to 'accepts_nil' to be Nil, not (Int32 | Nil)
cases.original_diagnostic_regex: expected argument #1 to 'accepts_nil' to be Nil, not \(Int32 \| Nil\)
cases.contract: Stock rejects because && retains the Int32 | Nil result; passing it to accepts_nil is invalid.

cases.name: filter_raw_nil_rhs_rejects
cases.contract: Raw literal Nil#bytesize remains a semantic error; no general dead-RHS pruning.

cases.name: filter_nil_function_receiver_rejects
cases.contract: A direct Nil-returning call does not establish a local-variable truthy filter; stock is expected to reject the receiver call.

cases.name: filter_nullable_local_legal_nil
cases.contract: A Nil actual in a nullable local short-circuits a legal narrowed Suffix#bytesize access.

cases.name: filter_nullable_local_legal_non_nil
cases.contract: A non-Nil nullable local enters the narrowed branch and invokes the valid bytesize method.

cases.name: filter_nullable_union_missing_method_rejects
cases.contract: The truthy set is nonempty for Suffix?, so a method missing from that reachable branch must still be rejected.

cases.name: filter_effectful_stable_local_once
cases.contract: The effectful left operand must execute once even though its Nil result makes the narrowed RHS unreachable.

cases.name: filter_nullable_value_bytesize_accepts_int32_or_nil
cases.contract: The value result of x && x.bytesize includes Nil, which accepts_int_or_nil admits; the Nil call should return true.

cases.name: nil_local_value_result_is_nil
cases.contract: The Nil-only local short-circuit expression retains Nil as its value and is accepted by a Nil-only consumer.

cases.name: nil_class_object_is_not_empty_value
cases.contract: The Nil type object is a class-object receiver; local-value truthy filtering must not treat it as an empty Nil runtime value.

cases.name: noreturn_class_object_is_not_empty_value
cases.contract: The NoReturn type object is still checked as a type-object receiver; empty-path filtering must not hide its invalid method call.

cases.name: false_and_missing_method_rejects
cases.contract: Runtime-constant Boolean operands do not hide an independent invalid RHS.

cases.name: true_or_missing_method_rejects
cases.contract: Runtime-constant Boolean operands do not hide an independent invalid RHS.

cases.name: false_and_effect_is_skipped
cases.contract: Semantic RHS visitation must retain runtime short-circuiting and skip its side effect.

cases.name: true_or_effect_is_skipped
cases.contract: Semantic RHS visitation must retain runtime short-circuiting and skip its side effect.

cases.name: false_and_retains_rhs_result
cases.contract: An independent RHS contributes its result type even when the Boolean left operand is constant.

cases.name: true_or_retains_rhs_result
cases.contract: An independent RHS contributes its result type even when the Boolean left operand is constant.
